notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Verdant Haven attached to a Forest you control.
description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
